## What changed

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior.

## How it was verified

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `go vet ./apps/backend/...`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant manual or end-to-end behavior was tested
- [ ] No credentials, terminal output, private paths, or generated state were committed

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] Authentication, encryption, relay, PTY, file-transfer, desktop-control, or update boundaries are unchanged
- [ ] If a boundary changed, the PR explains its threat model, failure behavior, and regression tests
- [ ] macOS/Linux behavior and rolling-update compatibility were considered

## AI assistance

- [ ] I understand and take responsibility for every submitted change, including AI-assisted code
- [ ] Generated claims were verified against code, tests, or primary documentation
